research_questions.RQ1: Under one fixed ACC tuning formulation, how do the six optimizers differ in solution quality, inter-run consistency, convergence, and computational cost?
research_questions.RQ2: To what extent do optimization differences appear in cruise and following responses, including profiles withheld from tuning?
research_questions.RQ3: How do fixed-gain performance, recovery, safety, and energy indicators change across the predeclared 12 physical-parameter conditions under matched road-load compensation?
research_questions.RQ4: With the optimizer and tuning protocol fixed, how does including jerk and positive tractive-energy terms change the optimized gains and evaluated controller behavior?

evaluation.controller_scope: all completed runs; strict coverage by default
evaluation.correlation_policy: within optimizer and within profile; exploratory, not causal
evaluation.default_actuator: instantaneous symmetric force limit, unchanged production plant
evaluation.primary_RQ3_scope: 12 declared physical conditions; all 180 fixed-gain controllers; matched actual/compensation parameters
excluded_from_primary_study: sensor noise and bias perturbation campaign

recovery.definition: elapsed delay to start of a qualifying hold; report completion time, observation window, and nonrecovered events too

ablation.weight_rule: retain ratios of surviving frozen weights, then normalize sum to one
ablation.pairing: identical explicit initial population and DE random seed per block
ablation.scope: conditional on canonical DE, frozen nominal FJE plant, and declared profiles
